subject.title: WhatsApp: Backfill missed messages after reconnection

question: Should WhatsApp reconnect recovery default to bounded catch-up auto-replies, an opt-in offline-message policy, provider-side history sync/warnings, or a staged combination?
rationale: Current code already allows very recent `append` messages, open PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80642 widens that default, and closed PRs proposed opt-in config; choosing the permanent delivery policy affects replay semantics for existing WhatsApp users.

options.title: Land bounded default catch-up first
options.body: Review and prove the open PR for Baileys-delivered reconnect `append` events while keeping this issue open for provider-side no-event backfill and warnings.

options.title: Require opt-in offline processing
options.body: Revive the config-gated approach so older reconnect backlog can be processed only when an operator explicitly enables it.

options.title: Design history sync first
options.body: Pause default delivery changes until `messaging-history.set` handling, sync limits, dedupe, and user-facing warnings are designed together.

recommendation.title: Land bounded default catch-up first
recommendation.body: Review and prove the open PR for Baileys-delivered reconnect `append` events while keeping this issue open for provider-side no-event backfill and warnings.

likelyOwner.reason: The current partial-fix PR and durable inbound path both route through recent steipete-owned work, while final policy still needs maintainer intent.
